name: Vant · Vant 4

title.zh: Vant · 按移动网页任务选组件

description.zh: 完整类型、边框、禁用与加载按钮组 Vant 为移动网页提供可定制的 Vue 界面组件，官网按基础、布局和交互控件列入口，Quickstart 说明安装与注册采用。Button 原例在手机式预览里完整比较类型、Plain、Hairline、Disabled 和 Loading，旁边给出 Vue 注册代码。可按具体控件接入移动网页；手机式预览不是原生 iOS 或 Android 应用测试。

reconstructionPrompt:
Build a high-quality, production-ready component inspired by Vant (https://vant-ui.github.io/vant/).
Technology stack: vue, css.
Component specification: 完整类型、边框、禁用与加载按钮组


Ensure clean semantic markup, fully accessible ARIA roles and keyboard interactions, responsive layout across desktop and mobile, crisp typography, and fluid state transitions (default, hover, active, focus).
